transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Lately, I've been eating extremely small amounts of food and skipping most of my meals. Because of this, my weight has been continuously dropping, which is why I'm here today.
Do you feel that your current weight or body shape has an excessive influence on how you feel about yourself as a person?
Yes, completely. If I gain even a tiny bit of weight, I feel like an absolute failure as a person. I only feel successful and good about myself when I manage to keep my weight down.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms, such as the loss of your menstrual period, feeling constantly cold, or experiencing dizziness when you stand up?
I haven't had my period in a few months, and I do get a little dizzy sometimes when I stand up. But it's really not a big deal and probably just because of stress, so I'm not worried about it at all.

No other diagnoses from the list are currently indicated.
